sources.note: Bibliography only. Bumbita index entry: 'Glasgow & Loving 1964, Laycock 1973, Tuzin 1973; d's W&H 1981'. Conrad's entries to 1996 list no Bumbita-specific phonology, only 'Conrad 1978 A survey of the Arapesh language family of Papua New Guinea, WPNGL 25: 57-77' and Bukiyip/Mufian/Iwam items.

sources.citation: Nekitel, Otto. 1985. Sociolinguistic aspects of Abu', a Papuan language of the Sepik area. PhD thesis, ANU. hdl 1885/132442
sources.tag: read: notes on stress
sources.note: ABU' (abua1245), not Bumbita: sec. 3.2.8 Stress pp.53-54, primary stress on the first vowel/diphthong of bi-/polysyllabic words, predictable and non-phonemic. Mentions Weri' (= Bumbita') only as a neighbouring language and credits Glasgow & Loving 1964 as the first account of the Arapesh area.

sources.citation: Dobrin, Lise M. (n.d.). Arapesh Grammar and Digital Language Archive, Phonology page (Cemaun Arapesh).https://www.arapesh.org/grammar_phonology.php
sources.tag: read: notes on stress
sources.note: CEMAUN (Mountain Arapesh coastal variety), not Bumbita: 'Primary word stress tends to fall on either the first or second syllable. Verbs must be specified for whether they take stress on the root or on the preceding vowel, and for whether or not stress advances with the addition of object or other suffixes.' Bumbita not mentioned.
